description.text: The fourth expansion pack of the Pokémon Card e series, released in Japan on 23 August 2002. It is set in the west of the mysterious continent, around a huge rift in the land, ancient pictures drawn across the ground and a village inside a crater, whose people appear on cards too. Its three secret cards, Golem, Kabutops and Ho-Oh, are Crystal Type Pokémon. With Mysterious Mountains it became Skyridge in English in May 2003, the last set Wizards of the Coast published.
